expected: T004 F02-AC-014 requires rejected candidate bodies to never become executable durable artifacts. admitBlueprint must admit only one stable validator-issued PASSED snapshot whose report/admissible pair cannot change between provenance verification and repository persistence.
actual: Post-closure exhaustive audit found a TOCTOU admission bypass in the merged T004 implementation. admitBlueprint reads caller-owned result.admissible/result.report multiple times. A getter/Proxy can return a genuine sealed PASSED report+admissible pair for isSealedPassedResult(), then return a forged PASSED report plus rejected-body admissible object on later reads. The repository then sees run.status=PASSED and run.blueprint_hash matching the forged content_hash and can persist a body that was never validator-issued. Deep-freezing the genuine sealed pair does not stop the outer result object from changing which pair it returns. Same-class audit also found that sealPassedResult itself is exported from admissible-provenance.ts. Any in-repo caller can construct an arbitrary PASSED report + arbitrary AdmissibleBlueprint, call the exported sealer, and thereby enroll that forged pair into the WeakMap accepted by admitBlueprint. The current provenance mechanism therefore protects against accidental object copying but does not reserve issuance authority to validateBlueprintCandidate.
evidence: Merged T004 implementation PR #188 source HEAD 89e078c2758a5f77a66bfa9d5da9a55596dc4e6f; canonical implementation merge 1918980b269fb11c11e386dd72d83bc7c5029003.

src/platform/blueprint/blueprint-admission.ts reads result.admissible for the rejected/PASSED branch, then reads result.report and result.admissible again for isSealedPassedResult(), then reads result.report again for runRecord(), then destructures result.admissible again before repository persistence.

Deterministic exploit order: admissible getter read #1 -> genuine sealed admissible; report getter #1 + admissible getter #2 -> genuine sealed pair passes WeakMap provenance; report getter #2 -> forged PASSED report; admissible getter #3 -> forged rejected-body content. PostgresBlueprintAdmissionRepository only requires PASSED + run.blueprint_hash === content.content_hash before executing admission.

admissible-provenance.ts deep-freezes the validator-issued report/admissible graph and binds exact admissible identity to exact report identity, but that invariant is checked only against one transient getter result and is not snapshotted for subsequent persistence reads.
Existing T004 forged-result regression cases use stable plain objects and therefore do not exercise accessor/Proxy identity switching after provenance verification.

This finding is implementation-only: BS-P1-012 already fixes the required semantics (only admitted validated Blueprint may become durable/executable; rejected candidate body must not). No Product/Schema decision is needed.

Prior T004 closure/evidence review is invalidated as sufficient closure proof by this post-closure counterexample. Existing EV-SP-P1-002-T004-001..010 remain historical records of the earlier green candidate/gates but must not be treated as sufficient completion evidence for final closure.

Same-class seal-authority audit: src/platform/blueprint/admissible-provenance.ts exports sealPassedResult(result), and repository-wide source scan shows only validate-blueprint.ts currently needs issuance while blueprint-admission.ts only needs verification. Because issuance is exported, a different caller can directly enroll a forged pair without passing the F02 pipeline.

Concrete direct-seal counterexample: construct report.status=PASSED with content_hash matching an arbitrary canonical body, construct matching AdmissibleBlueprint, call exported sealPassedResult(), then pass returned pair to admitBlueprint(); isSealedPassedResult succeeds because the exported sealer itself populated issuedReports.

The fix must reserve issuance authority to the validator module. A valid implementation shape is to keep issuedReports/deepFreeze/private seal inside validate-blueprint.ts and export only a read-only verification predicate for blueprint-admission.ts; any equivalent design is acceptable only if non-validator callers cannot mint provenance.

attempts.evidence: Independent audit re-read the complete T004 diff and its adjacent validator/repository/execution boundaries and constructed a caller-owned accessor/Proxy counterexample that crosses the provenance check with a genuine pair then substitutes forged persistence inputs.

requested_planning_action: Reopen T004 under the same locked BS-P1-012; do not create a Product/Design delta.

Remove public/in-repo minting authority for validator provenance. sealPassedResult (or equivalent issuer) must not be callable by arbitrary callers; only validateBlueprintCandidate may mint an admissible provenance entry. Admission may import a verification predicate, but not an issuer.

Add a regression proving arbitrary callers cannot mint provenance for a forged PASSED result. The test must fail against the current exported-sealer design and pass only when issuance authority is validator-private.
At admitBlueprint entry, read result.report and result.admissible exactly once into stable local snapshots before any branch/provenance decision; after snapshot, never read caller-owned result again.
For PASSED admission, verify isSealedPassedResult(snapshotReport, snapshotAdmissible) and build both ValidationRunRecord and BlueprintContentRecord exclusively from those verified snapshots.

Add an adversarial regression using getter/Proxy-backed BlueprintValidationResult that returns a genuine sealed pair for the provenance read and then attempts to swap in a forged PASSED report/rejected candidate body; assert no blueprint_content write and no executable durable artifact.
Add a same-class accessor test for the rejected branch so a changing caller-owned report cannot create inconsistent validation evidence during one admitBlueprint invocation.
Re-run every T004 required command and CI-style scope/test-integrity gate from the new canonical reactivation base; independently re-audit before merge.
Normalize fresh T004 Evidence after the fix. Do not reuse the old review evidence as final completion proof.
